mapper.select: SELECT t1.fnd00_fund_id AS fund_id , t1.fnd00_fund_cd AS fund_code , t1.fnd00_fund_nm AS fund_name , t1.fnd00_fund_type_nm AS fund_type_name , t1.fnd00_org_code_nm AS org_code_name , CAST(t1.fnd00_start_date AS date) AS start_date , t1.fnd00_close_nm AS close_name , t1.fnd00_note AS note FROM fnd00_fund t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.fnd00_work_date = f_max_workdate(fnd00_fund_id, f_trunc(f_sysdate())) AND t1.fnd00_plan_yn = 'false' AND t1.fnd00_close_yn IN ('false', #{closeYn}) AND (t1.fnd00_fund_cd LIKE #{fundName} OR t1.fnd00_fund_nm LIKE #{fundName}) AND t1.fnd00_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY fnd00_fund_cd

SELECT fnd00_fund_id AS fund_id , fnd00_fund_cd AS fund_code , fnd00_fund_nm AS fund_name , fnd00_kofia_fund_type_nm AS kofia_fund_type_name , fnd00_kofia_class_type_nm AS kofia_class_type_name , fnd00_consignment_nm AS consignment_name , CAST(fnd00_start_date AS date) AS start_date , fnd00_emp1_nm AS emp_name1 , fnd00_note AS note FROM fnd00_fund_sysdate WHERE fnd00_company_id = #{companyId} AND fnd00_close_yn IN ('false', #{closeYn}) AND fnd00_plan_yn = #{planYn} AND fnd00_kofia_fund_type_cd LIKE #{fundType} AND UPPER(fnd00_fund_cd||fnd00_fund_nm) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND fnd00_kofia_class_type_cd IN ('1','Z')
ORDER BY fnd00_fund_cd
